title: Phone Posture Check
surface: grey self-healing cutting mat with grid
cut_style: flat app-icon style cutouts with rounded corners and bright UI colors
voice: Friendly, clear, brisk narrator at about 170 WPM; warm and practical with upbeat clarity.

cuts.slouched_phone_figure: Simple side-view paper cutout of a person looking down at a smartphone, head forward and shoulders rounded, bright colors, no text or symbols.
cuts.forward_head_arrow: Paper cutout showing a head and neck profile drifting forward with a bold curved arrow, no text, letters, or numbers.
cuts.rounded_shoulders: Paper cutout of an upper torso with shoulders curling inward and a plain height silhouette beside it, no markings or text.
cuts.eye_level_phone: Paper cutout of an upright person holding a smartphone at eye level with a straight stacked posture, no text or symbols.
cuts.chin_tuck_profile: Paper cutout of a face profile gently sliding the chin backward with a small arrow, neutral expression, no text or numbers.

scenes.vo: Is your phone making you shorter?
Looking down pulls your head forward for hours.
Your shoulders round, so you appear shorter.
Lift your phone until your eyes look straight.
Then try three slow chin tucks now.
Get your personal routine in TallPlan.
